description: Confirmation enforcement (spec/command-metadata.md, "Confirmations") against a backend started with CONFIRMATIONS=enforce, where todo-clear declares confirmPrompt. Each case names the client it needs: "acknowledge" declares no elicitation capability, so the backend must accept an acknowledgement; "accept" and "decline" declare form elicitation and answer every confirmation that way. The runner resets the store before each case; "then" checks the state afterwards.

tests.name: Unconfirmed clear is refused
tests.description: Without a confirmation the command does not run and nothing is deleted

tests.name: Acknowledged clear runs
tests.description: confirm: true is stripped before validation and the command runs

tests.name: Commands without confirmPrompt are not gated
Accepted elicitation runs the command
tests.description: The backend asks through elicitation and the user accepts

tests.name: Declined elicitation refuses the command
tests.description: The user declines; nothing is deleted and the agent is told not to retry
